experiment: SG-A3G: GoCA-oriented A3 layer score, paired control and V3 robustness

cell_definitions.V0: historical A3 seed (Section 107 orientation, <M^T,P>) -> observation-wise FINE-P2; same-generation reference
cell_definitions.V3: historical A3 seed -> SG-combined-v2 V3 (one-sided raw cap at 16->32)
cell_definitions.G0: GoCA-oriented A3G seed (<M,P>, second permute(2,3,0,1) restored) -> FINE-P2

seed_pairing: A3 and A3G are accumulated by one recorder during one diffusion run per image; they differ only in the per-call CA module weights of resized modules
ca: frozen A3 class-word W: SD1.5, selected eleven CA modules, calls 0-30, all heads; A3G changes only the affinity orientation
sa: unchanged SG-combined-v2 sources and operators (src/segmentation/sg_combined_v2.py), no new parameter
primary_questions: G0+R2 vs V0+R2: does the working-default control move by more than the 0.002 tie band (Section 107 addendum)?
G3 vs G0 and G3 vs V3, raw and R2: does the V3 gain survive the corrected seed?
selection: five frozen VOC folds; raw and R2 screens separately versus same-generation V0 with candidates V3, G0, G3; registered promotion guard unchanged; forced OOF, pairwise wins and selector reported separately; full-VOC thresholds frozen for COCO; no COCO tuning
diagnostics: per-image seed difference (mean absolute min-max seed difference, Pearson r) and call-mean absolute layer-weight difference; raw-map AP and best-threshold mIoU; mean-image IoU change by GT area fraction bin (0-0.1, 0.1-0.25, 0.25-0.5, 0.5-0.75, >=0.75); worst class per cell. Diagnostic only
storage: resumable per-image confusion counts and compact diagnostics; no generated image, mask, dense map, QK or affinity cache
